latest_release.name: v0.20.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Sum GPTBigCode's shared key/value gradient across tensor-parallel ranks by @Achyuthan-S in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8928
* [AffineIR] Storage maps of AutoEP experts under EDP and ZeRO by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8941
* Add klxpu (KUNLUNXIN XPU) self-hosted CI for the v1 unit suite by @GuCarpenter in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8923
* ZeRO-3: copy offloaded master weights back to the device through pinned buffer by @pengdurice in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8840
* ci: pin torch<2.15 for MPS workflow until pytorch/pytorch#202529 is fixed by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8955
* [Hybrid Engine] Enable graph capture for HybridEngine on non-CUDA accelerators by @VenusTZZ in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8933
* Cap CPU accelerator memory at the cgroup limit of the process by @prabhkodes in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8930
* [VocabTP] vocab_parallel_ce support fused LM-head projection + loss for the HF forward by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8945
* ZeRO-1/2: preserve gradients across request boundaries until step by @stas00 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8949
* Update version.txt post-v0.19.9 release by @loadams in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8999
* Add an opt-in deterministic execution policy by @ziming-zh in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8917
* Keep float32 intermediates in the clamped SwiGLU eager fallback by @GuCarpenter in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8992
* ZeRO-3: build the partial-offload device string from the public accelerator API by @GuCarpenter in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8994
* [checkpoint] Execute affine transfer plans with bounded peer staging by @0z5a in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8809
* XPU: register pinned host memory via Level Zero ext_memmap by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8887
* [AutoTP] Support frozen AutoTP models and manage AutoTP mode per model by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8851
* Fix torch-latest workflow unit failures by @sfc-gh-truwase in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8950
* Count each expert once in the fp32 gradient-clipping norm by @alanhuangyoo in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8478
* Support Transformers 5.20 cache query offsets in DeepSpeedStaticCache by @nathon-lee in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8852
* Fix bug in Adagrad optimizer initialization by @hwchen2017 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8976
* Fix AutoEP storage-map transfer test for CPU tensor views by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/9012
* Clear stale offload scratch before restoring low-precision gradients by @adenzhou1350 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8728
* Check that converting through an affine map writes every element once by @Achyuthan-S in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8975
* [Hybrid Engine] Require an explicit accelerator opt-in for graph capture by @VenusTZZ in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8980
* ZeRO-3: reuse the weight partition as the master copy when it already has the master dtype by @pengdurice in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8842
* AutoEP + AutoTP folding: allow CPU optimizer offload under ZeRO-3 by @0z5a in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8829
* Run the v1 multi-rank CPU suite on pull requests by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8944
* fix(rollout): pass a pre-built 4-D mask to the static graph decode forward by @anyadontfly in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/9004
* AutoEP activation tests: skip the Triton grouped-GEMM path when Triton cannot run by @GuCarpenter in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8996
*
